snippet.title: 🌀 MASKS OF THE VOID:ORIGINS  TRAILER 🌀
snippet.description:
Discover our exclusive #Trailer of '#MasksOfTheVoid: Origins':

Throw everything that surrounds you within this telekinesis-based rogue-lite with the power of the masks! Dive into the Void, uncover the mysteries of the Masks, and face what lies beyond life and death. What will you do to protect your home from obliteration?
You are Iret, a girl who has obtained a power and with it, the task to prevent a Neverending Night. Empower yourself or your allies in this journey!
